implementation.motivation: The existing lower read adapter deliberately accepts portable caller-supplied original plan/block DATA on later stages and owns no original-plan/block lifecycle. This new composition retains those originals privately for one selected local unsigned attempt. This is a finite composition gap, not a global novelty claim.
api: createObservedDynamicPlasmaUserSendAttempt({transports, accountExchange}) constructs the existing read adapter ONCE and captures its four methods.
quote(inputV2) is admitted once in NEW and retains the returned ORIGINAL subject/quote/acknowledgement.
createWorkRequest(inputV2) is admitted in QUOTED and uses that retained plan; no plan argument is accepted.

assemble(inputV2, suppliedMaterial) is admitted in WORK_REQUESTED, invokes the existing assembly/complete consumer and retains that SAME unsigned account block; no later assembly or caller block is accepted.
validateUnsigned(inputV2) is admitted in ASSEMBLED/VALIDATED and can repeat only against the retained original plan and SAME unsigned block. No block/plan argument is accepted.
implementation.state: NEW -> QUOTED -> WORK_REQUESTED -> ASSEMBLED -> VALIDATED. Wrong arity/order refuses before input inspection without changing state. Busy and HELD precede hostile input. Any admitted operation failure sets permanent HELD, including a pre-read refusal; originals are not forgotten/replaced and there is no reset.
implementation.v2Boundary: Every admitted stage requires explicit existing read input v2, including the selected-balance gate. A v1 downgrade refuses before another account/DP handoff and holds this instance. The standalone lower adapter's v1 behavior is unchanged; this is NOT a global downgrade, signer-state or authority fence.
implementation.snapshots: The captured existing method snapshots selected input/material synchronously before its first await. Original quote/subject/ack and unsigned assembly are trusted frozen component DATA retained in closure. Returned stage shapes are unchanged. Caller input/material is not frozen or mutated.
implementation.price: Later observations can advance inside the ORIGINAL quote's policy horizon. They never refresh its acknowledgement, reprice/reassemble the original block or authorize replacement/re-signing. Original-account mismatch and horizon expiry hold the attempt.
implementation.reads: No additional RPC method, exchange option, endpoint, native owner, transport recreation, read-cycle retry or fallback. Existing account wire has32 handoffs: at most16 complete two-read cycles. Sequence quote/work/assembly plus13 same-block validations reaches that existing budget; another validation holds without another accountExchange handoff.
implementation.promises: Own returned native Promise is shielded from a borrowed capability's inherited-constructor mutation. Existing intrinsic checks are rechecked before/after the delegated stage; errors have fixed frozen code/message/stack and no raw cause. This is not a sandbox against arbitrary caller capabilities.
implementation.nonGoals: Volatile local DATA sequencing only, NOT durable original-request/payment custody, process-restart recovery, consumed authority, exclusive ownership across instances or an unforgeable signing capability. A new instance grants no replacement/re-signing right. External signing cannot be detected; callers must stop these methods before signing and preserve exact original signed bytes/hash/context elsewhere.
implementation.noCutover: No SDK/current-state preparation, real PREPARE, nonce/work/key producer/search, signing, payment/publication, provider setup, native connection owner, broad app/store/controller qualification or active buyer/planner change.
